source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Enter BMC Web UI -> Click tab "Dashboard"
And also enter "Server Health" -> "Sensor Reading"

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: Sensor Reading & Threshold is human reable and match with spec.

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: ipmitool -I lanplus -C 17 -H "$BMC_IP" -U "$BMC_USER" -P "$BMC_PASS" sensor get 'SEL_RealErr_Full' 2>&1; echo ---SDR-FALLBACK---; ipmitool -I lanplus -C 17 -H "$BMC_IP" -U "$BMC_USER" -P "$BMC_PASS" sdr elist 2>&1 | head -100

original_test_intent: Verify that the Sensor Page representation associated with `SEL_RealErr_Full` is human-readable and that the exact sensor's current reading/state and applicable warning/critical thresholds, units and status agree with the platform specification across Dashboard, Server Health and an authoritative OOB source.
original_method: Open Dashboard and Server Health > Sensor Reading, identify the row intended by the case label, capture its displayed value/threshold/status and compare it with the corresponding complete SDR or supported API record and Project specification. No threshold change, fault stimulus, SEL fill or log clear is part of this row's written procedure.
manual_activity: The Project/FAE owner maps the case label to the exact platform sensor and supplies expected values, units and threshold semantics. Automation can collect and normalize read-only UI/OOB evidence; an operator resolves ambiguous labels or visual formatting and the engineer owns the result. No physical/error stimulus is authorized.
required_inputs: Exact BMC/chassis/firmware/WebUI/SDR repository identity and account role
Stable sensor ID/name/number/type/entity/instance plus mapping to Dashboard and Server Health row
Expected reading or state, units, conversion/scaling, tolerance, status and upper/lower noncritical/critical/nonrecoverable thresholds where applicable
Rules for discrete versus analog sensors, absent/unavailable thresholds, hysteresis, stale/cache age, disabled/not-readable and assertion state
Validated ipmitool/API/browser versions, supported authentication/cipher and protected secrets
Pinned immutable accessible `sensor.git` revision/checksum and content/dependency safety review, or an approved manual collection method
safety_requirements: Do not clear SEL, dmesg or system logs; clearing is unrelated to read-only sensor-page validation and destroys diagnostic context.
Do not assume `SEL_RealErr_Full` is the literal SDR name or select a similar substring. Bind the UI row and OOB record using stable IDs/type/entity metadata and stop on missing or duplicate matches.
Do not use `head -100` or terminal truncation for fallback evidence. Capture the complete exact matching SDR record and command status; empty/missing output is not PASS.

Do not change thresholds, acknowledge faults, inject sensor states, heat/cool hardware or fill SEL. Those dynamic actions belong to separately approved coverage and cannot be inferred from this UI-only Procedure.
Do not expose passwords with `-P`, assume cipher 17 or execute the inaccessible Script until a pinned revision is reviewed for target, reads/writes, clear behavior, secrets and retries.
Stop without retry on identity/unit/scaling ambiguity, UI/OOB mismatch beyond freshness/tolerance, reserved/unavailable values, unexpected mutation or BMC instability; preserve first evidence.
agent_execution_scope: Validate target/client and exact sensor mapping, inspect the pinned Script if supplied, then capture BMC time, complete SDR/API identity, reading/state, units, status and all applicable thresholds without mutation.
Capture the Dashboard and Server Health representations for the same sensor and their timestamps/refresh behavior; normalize only according to the approved scaling/rounding rules.
Compare identity, reading/state, units, thresholds and health/status with Project SPEC and report unavailable/stale/extra/mismatched fields separately.
Re-read to prove no state change, preserve redacted raw/UI evidence and never clear logs, create a fault, retry automatically or issue DUT PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve the exact `SEL_RealErr_Full` sensor mapping and distinguish this read-only Sensor Page row from the dynamic row-764 test.
Provide expected values, units/scaling/tolerance, threshold/hysteresis/status and freshness rules plus a pinned Script or alternate method.
Review UI/OOB/spec discrepancies and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Potentially usable only after proving the literal sensor name and protected IPMI transport. As written it assumes identity, exposes a password, may use an unsupported cipher, provides no WebUI/spec comparison and truncates the fallback, so it cannot substantiate `FULL` or human-readable/spec match.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Resolve the exact sensor by stable SDR identity, capture its complete supported OOB/API record and both WebUI views through protected access, then compare normalized reading/state, unit, thresholds, status and freshness with the approved specification; use the internal Script only after immutable review.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The `SEL_RealErr_Full` label, Dashboard and Server Health paths, human-readable/spec Criteria, source clear text, internal Script URL, DeepSeek commands and 1/0-minute estimates remain preserved; no dynamic threshold or SEL-fill action is added.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Perform a read-only canonical sensor join across exact SDR/API identity, Dashboard and Server Health, with version-matched units/scaling/threshold semantics and timestamp/freshness controls.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: The exact BMC firmware/SDR/WebUI build for which the case label is mapped to a stable sensor and Project expectations exist.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BMC firmware, SDR package, WebUI build, client and pinned Script revision/checksum.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform sensor/SDR specification, WebUI field definition and Project expected-value matrix.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Makes sensor identity and field semantics explicit, validates both UI locations and complete OOB data, protects credentials/evidence and avoids unrelated destructive setup.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Read-only presence/value comparison does not prove threshold transition, assert/deassert, real-error stimulus or SEL-capacity behavior; those remain separate and unverified.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Sensor mapping, expected field matrix, freshness/tolerance, validated tool or reviewed Script and protected access.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Rendered values can be rounded or cached; some sensors are discrete or lack readable thresholds; wrong name matching can silently select another sensor.

project_override_considerations: A Project may use Redfish/OEM telemetry instead of ipmitool when it records the preserved OOB proposal, actual interface/version, reason, engineer approval, stable field equivalence and any unverified UI/ipmitool coverage. It cannot claim the dynamic `SEL_RealErr_Full`/SEL-capacity behavior of another row from this read-only evidence.
expected_evidence: Target BMC/chassis, firmware/WebUI/SDR identities, trusted access and exact case-label-to-sensor/UI mapping
Complete nontruncated raw SDR/API record with sensor number/type/entity, reading or discrete state, units/scaling, thresholds/hysteresis/status and timestamp
Redacted Dashboard and Server Health row evidence with route, refresh timestamp and same stable identity
Approved Project expected-value/threshold matrix and field-level normalized comparison including tolerance, absent/NA/stale rules
Pinned Script commit/checksum/content review or approved alternate method and protected command audit without credentials
Before/after no-clear/no-write proof, mismatch/limitation report, BMC health and engineer-owned verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Within this Sensor Page row, title, UI navigation and Criteria consistently support a read-only reading/threshold/spec check. The similarly titled dynamic row 764 is a separate Source Identity and does not make this row contradictory; exact sensor mapping is a Project readiness input.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The read-only UI/spec comparison is identifiable. Sensor identity, expected values, decoder and Script content are supplyable Project/vendor inputs, so this is PACKAGE rather than permanent BLOCKED; execution waits for them.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Changes YES to PACKAGE, retains only a fully validated exact sensor read and rejects name assumptions, truncated fallback, credential leakage and missing UI/spec evidence.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Agrees on hybrid read-only classification and adds separate field types, immutable Script governance and an explicit non-equivalence boundary with row 764 dynamic coverage.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.round_02: Replaces command-exists reasoning with stable identity, full record, UI/spec and freshness validation.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.related_v3_1: Keeps row 764's unresolved dynamic thermal/SEL-fill test separate rather than importing its blocker or claiming its coverage.

review_improvement: Prevents a same-looking sensor name or truncated SDR list from being accepted as the target, and prevents a readable value from being mistaken for correct units, thresholds, freshness or dynamic error coverage.
independent_technical_reasoning: Sensor displays are meaningful only when identity, engineering units, scaling, threshold availability and freshness are bound to the same record. Dashboard and Server Health can format or cache the same backend differently, so comparison needs a canonical SDR/API anchor rather than literal text alone. Because this row contains no stimulus, a complete review must not invent one or conflate it with the earlier dynamic test.
